limitations.required_evidence: Independent implementation, component conformance execution, and fault-injection evidence.
limitations.statement: This component canon is a normative decomposition; no independent component implementation has yet demonstrated semantic conformance.

limitations.required_evidence: External exact-byte audit of the component release.
limitations.statement: The extraction preserves rc11 semantics but the new component release bytes have not received an external third-party audit.

boundary_invariants.statement: Memory retrieval is advisory and does not establish authority or verification.

context_components.content: facts, provenance, epistemic status, scoped memory projection

description.en: Produce a scoped provenance-preserving memory projection without promoting epistemic status.
description.pt-BR: Constrói uma projeção limitada da memória com proveniência e estado epistêmico explícito.
description.ru: Строит ограниченную проекцию памяти с происхождением и явным эпистемическим статусом.

seed_mapping.justification: Mapped by operation class to ASET Seed 0.1-rc12; local computations create no authority or recognized Outcome.

description.en: Apply an authorized memory lifecycle mutation and emit a receipt.
description.pt-BR: Altera a memória governada somente por meio de uma transição atômica autorizada.
description.ru: Изменяет управляемую память только через разрешённый атомарный переход.

seed_mapping.justification: The operation changes governed state, authority, evidence, or external-effect status and therefore uses the declared Seed sequence.

purpose.en: Preserves provenance, episodes, and memory projections without turning retrieval into authority or a verified fact.
purpose.pt-BR: Preserva proveniência, episódios e projeções de memória sem transformar retrieval em autoridade ou fato verificado.
purpose.ru: Сохраняет происхождение, эпизоды и проекции памяти без превращения retrieval в полномочие или проверенный факт.
